name: ORS Property Location History
description: The history of property stored at property locations at an establishment. Replaces ACC0023.

dataset.name: Prisons
dataset.query: select prison_id, name prison_name FROM prisons.prisonregister_prison p where p.active = true order by name

dataset.name: Property Location History
dataset.query:
WITH all_events AS (
    SELECT e.id,
           e.property_container_id,
           e.event_type,
           e.event_datetime,
           e.to_internal_location_id,
           e.to_storage_location_type,
           LAST_VALUE(e.seal_number) IGNORE NULLS OVER (
               PARTITION BY e.property_container_id
               ORDER BY e.event_datetime, e.id
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS seal_number,
           LAST_VALUE(COALESCE(e.to_internal_location_id, e.to_storage_location_type)) IGNORE NULLS OVER (
               PARTITION BY e.property_container_id
               ORDER BY e.event_datetime, e.id
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_location
    FROM prisons.prisonerproperty_property_event e
),
location_changes AS (
    SELECT id,
           property_container_id,
           event_datetime,
           seal_number,
           CASE WHEN event_type IN ('TRANSFERRED', 'RETURNED', 'DISPOSED', 'COMBINED', 'CREATED_IN_ERROR', 'REMOVED')
                THEN NULL
                ELSE last_known_location
           END AS location_key
    FROM all_events
    WHERE to_internal_location_id IS NOT NULL
       OR to_storage_location_type IS NOT NULL
       OR event_type IN ('REACTIVATED', 'TRANSFERRED', 'RETURNED', 'DISPOSED', 'COMBINED', 'CREATED_IN_ERROR', 'REMOVED')
),
periods AS (
    SELECT property_container_id,
           seal_number,
           location_key,
           event_datetime AS moved_in,
           LEAD(event_datetime) OVER (
               PARTITION BY property_container_id
               ORDER BY event_datetime, id) AS moved_out
    FROM location_changes
),
prisoner AS (
    SELECT o.offender_id_display AS prisoner_number,
           o.first_name,
           o.last_name
    FROM prisons.nomis_offenders o
    JOIN prisons.nomis_offender_bookings b ON b.offender_id = o.offender_id
    WHERE b.booking_seq = 1
)
SELECT c.prison_id,
       CASE WHEN p.location_key = 'BRANSTON' THEN 'Branston' ELSE COALESCE(l.local_name, l.path_hierarchy, 'Unknown location') END AS location_name,
       p.seal_number,
       CASE c.container_type
            WHEN 'STANDARD' THEN 'Standard'
            WHEN 'EXCESS' THEN 'Excess'
            WHEN 'VALUABLES' THEN 'Valuables'
            WHEN 'CONFISCATED' THEN 'Confiscated'
            ELSE c.container_type
       END AS container_type,
       CAST(p.moved_in AS date)  AS date_in,
       CAST(p.moved_out AS date) AS date_out,
       c.removal_date,
       CASE WHEN c.removal_outcome IS NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS active_flag,
       c.prisoner_number,
       INITCAP(n.first_name) AS first_name,
       INITCAP(n.last_name) AS last_name
FROM periods p
JOIN prisons.prisonerproperty_property_container c ON c.id = p.property_container_id
LEFT JOIN prisons.locationsinsideprison_location l ON l.id = p.location_key
LEFT JOIN prisoner n ON n.prisoner_number = c.prisoner_number
WHERE p.location_key IS NOT NULL
  AND (p.moved_out IS NULL OR p.moved_out > p.moved_in)
  AND COALESCE(c.removal_outcome, '') <> 'CREATED_IN_ERROR'

report.name: Property Location History
report.description: The history of property stored at property locations at an establishment. Replaces ACC0023.
